recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a male subject wearing a dark denim hoodie. The lighting is directional, casting deep shadows that obscure the periphery while highlighting the facial features and a prominent iced-out Cuban link chain. The background is absolute black, creating a stark, moody atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the dark skin tones and the brilliant white sparkle of the jewelry
The hood framing the face to create a sense of mystery and focus
Directional light source creating a sharp fall-off across the bridge of the nose
Textural contrast between the matte denim fabric and the reflective metallic chain
coreInvariants: Subject centered in a tight close-up crop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame in a tight head-and-shoulders crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the reflective Cuban link chain serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the illuminated side of the face, follows the shadow line down to the bright chain, and then circles back to the eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space surrounding the hood, merging the subject's silhouette into the black background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays provide the foundation and atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm, mid-tone brown skin tones provide the human element.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool white and silver highlights from the jewelry and eye reflections.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Very low saturation overall, relying on extreme value shifts from 0% to 95% brightness to define form.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to monochromatic and natural skin tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with varying weights and widths used within a contained graphic box.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed nature of standard advisory labels.
Provides a similar industrial, authoritative feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key studio portrait of a Black man in a dark denim hoodie against a pure black background. Use a single light source from the side to create dramatic shadows. Include a highly detailed, sparkling silver Cuban link chain around his neck. Focus on skin texture and the glint in the eyes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, white rectangular graphic in the bottom right corner containing three rows of bold, condensed sans-serif text separated by thin horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting directional enough to leave half the face in shadow?
Does the jewelry have high-specular highlights?
Is the text box positioned in the lower right quadrant?

adjustableVariables: Texture of the hoodie fabric (denim vs. cotton)
Thickness and style of the jewelry
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the clothing

mustAchieve: Clean separation of the chain links
Smooth skin gradients in the lit areas

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shadow side of the face is dark but retains subtle form.
Check that the chain looks metallic and reflective, not flat gray.
Verify the hoodie texture is visible in the highlights.
Confirm the overall mood is serious and dramatic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key lighting + Dark Subject + Metallic Accent + Black Void = Urban Dramatic Portraiture.
